name: Technical business consultation
headline: Get clarity before committing capital.
audience: Founders and operators with a defined fintech or technology question.
includes: Written summary of decisions and open questions
Prioritized next actions and relevant service pathways
inputs: A short project brief, target market and key questions.
excludes: Legal opinion, licensing application, code implementation and external specialist fees.
acceptance: One session and written action summary delivered.

name: Market entry research
headline: Compare two markets before you expand.
audience: Fintech founders and established businesses evaluating two target jurisdictions.
includes: Operating dependencies, unresolved assumptions and next-step checklist
inputs: Business model, two target jurisdictions, intended activities and launch timeline.
excludes: Legal opinions, definitive licence eligibility, company filing, tax advice and government fees.
acceptance: Two-market comparison and source register delivered and reviewed.

name: Fintech launch roadmap
headline: Turn an ambitious launch into an executable plan.
audience: Founders preparing a payments, digital banking, wallet, trading or other fintech business.
includes: Prioritized implementation backlog, decision owners and launch sequence
inputs: Product brief, intended users, budget range, target markets and existing systems.
excludes: Code delivery, fundraising, regulatory approvals, vendor charges and licensed legal advice.
acceptance: Written roadmap, assumptions and agreed next milestones delivered.

name: Technology architecture assessment
headline: Identify expensive infrastructure risks early.
audience: Teams selecting, building or upgrading fintech infrastructure.
includes: Review of agreed system architecture and integrations
Findings register prioritized by impact and dependency
Technical recommendations and an implementation plan
inputs: Non-sensitive architecture diagrams, integration inventory and target requirements.
excludes: Penetration testing, certification, live deployment, remediation and third-party subscriptions.
acceptance: Findings and recommendations delivered for the agreed architecture scope.
